caption: The video captures a clear plastic water bottle suspended upside down between the black legs of a tripod, its blue cap pointing toward the ground on a sunny day. Behind the tripod, a strip of green lawn meets a pale concrete patio, where a dark wet streak runs downward beneath the bottle. Inside the bottle, a white elongated object is visible near the neck. The hanging bottle appears largely steady relative to the tripod, with only slight apparent variation. The white object maintains a similar tilt inside the bottle. Small wet marks surround the lower edge of the streak, while the streak itself remains beneath the cap. The tripod legs, lawn, and concrete edge remain fixed, indicating a static camera.
